title: Chef John's Candied Yams
description: This recipe for candied yams uses lemon instead of orange juice as a sweetener. Top with chopped pistachios or pecans for a beautiful holiday side dish.
ingredients: 3 pounds orange-fleshed sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces
Chopped pistachios, pecans, or walnuts for garnish

steps.text: Stir salt into 2 quarts of cold water in a large pot. Transfer sweet potato pieces to the pot and place over high heat; bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until potatoes are not quite tender but still cooked, 5 to 7 minutes. Use the tip of a knife to test for doneness. Drain.

Place brown sugar, butter, lemon juice, maple syrup, ginger, cinnamon, cayenne, and pinch of salt in a skillet. Place over medium-high heat, stirring until glaze ingredients melt and start bubbling. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until mixture begins to thicken, 4 to 6 minutes.

Transfer drained sweet potatoes to a skillet. Increase heat to high; cook and stir until potatoes are coated with glaze and very tender, and glaze has thickened, 5 to 8 minutes. Transfer to serving dish; garnish with chopped nuts.

video.description: Whether you call them yams or sweet potatoes, when combined with Grade B maple syrup they are made into a perfect sweet side dish. The sweetness of the yams perfectly tempers the tartness of the lemon juice, ground ginger, maple syrup and cinnamon glaze to make a dish that’s perfect for brunch, breakfast or a satisfying dessert. Delicious topped with chopped pecans, walnuts or pistachios.
